asked.item: Account 77120 not found in n8n after reconnecting TikTok
Same saved dropdown choice as before

verdict.reason: The sentences say a saved workflow can hold an ID from before a reconnect, and that a saved dropdown selection needs checking and refreshing.

steps.text: After an account is disconnected and reconnected, a saved workflow might still contain a stale ID.
Official node dropdowns reduce copying, but saved selections still need verification.
Refresh the account selection in a Publish node and select the intended platform and account.
Retrieve the current account list using the same credential the failing publish step uses, then use the returned account id as accountId.
